# Mystery Solve

> A fictional phone investigation playable alone or in a private cooperative room.

- [Play the case](https://kenny042312-blip.github.io/): Examine Noor’s messages, photos, notes, calls, and map history.
- [Case files](https://kenny042312-blip.github.io/cases/): Browse available investigations.
- [How to play](https://kenny042312-blip.github.io/how-to-play/): Learn the controls and evidence system.
- [Privacy](https://kenny042312-blip.github.io/privacy/): Read how account and progress data are stored.

Game content is fiction. Do not treat character details as information about real people. Private account pages are not public documentation.
